question_text: Republic Act No. 7586, the National Integrated Protected Areas System (NIPAS) Act of 1992, designates certain areas as protected areas. Which of the following acts is prohibited within a protected area under this law?

options.text: Hunting of endangered species for scientific research with a permit from the DENR.
Collection of forest products for personal use by indigenous communities.
Mining and exploration activities within the protected area.
Establishment of ecotourism facilities with an environmental compliance certificate.
